title: Pathfinder CRB player catalog (minimal)
license: Mechanics-only curated numbers. No Product Identity. No class flavor or spell text.

batches.notes: Ability modifiers are engine-owned. This pack adds Fighter and Wizard progression tags.
HP dialog records physical HD rolls. Iteratives are engine-owned BAB math.
AC/touch/FF and CMB/CMD are engine-owned. No catalog. CMD uses uncapped Dex.
Skill total is engine-owned. Class-skill lists wait for batch 9. Over-cap ranks warn and are not clamped.
Size tables are engine-owned. Goldens stay Medium. Quadruped carry waits.
Encumbrance is engine-owned. Medium/heavy penalties are not auto-written. ignoreWeight opts out of load category.
Spell DC and bonus slots are engine-owned. Slots stay user-entered. Spell Focus does not change DC. Bonus slots are not added into max.
Human catalog id and name only. Ability adjustments stay typed into scores. Size is not stamped.
Fighter/Wizard class-skill lists and 2 skill points per level. Checkboxes stamp on class pick. Ranks are not auto-spent. Human +1/level is in the pool when race.human.
Documentary catalog ids for the golden weapons and armor. Stamps name, pounds, and weapon/armor fields. Does not write armorClass or attacks.
Same class catalog row as Fighter/Wizard for the other 9 CRB base classes. Apply/stamp/pool reuse batch 1 and 9. No class features or spell lists.
Documentary catalog ids for the golden feats. Stamps name and category. Does not write Combat math or summaries.
Documentary catalog ids for the golden spells. Stamps name and spell level. Does not write slots, DCs, or prepared flags.
Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Half-Elf, Half-Orc, Halfling plus Human size. Apply stamps identity.size. Ability adjustments stay typed. Languages and speeds are not stamped.
Documentary CRB simple weapons except packed dagger/quarterstaff, plus simple ammo bundles. Combat stays typed. No unarmed strike. No martial/exotic.
Documentary CRB martial light and remaining martial one-handed weapons. Skip packed longsword. No shield-bash or spiked-armor rows. Combat stays typed.
Documentary CRB martial two-handed weapons and martial bows plus arrows bundle. Composite Strength rating stays typed. Combat stays typed. No Special tags yet.
